title: Trying to build the handheld game I've wanted since I was a kid
author: Twatclot
selftext:
As a kid, so long ago, I always wanted my Might Max and Tamagotchis to be one and the same. I wanted to be able to physically open the doors and see what was behind them or to see how characters would interact with each other. I'd dream up mysteries that could be hidden within the physical qualities of a toy playset, creating another layer of fantasy to keep my mind entertained. I had fun taking care of my little virtual pets and seeing what they turned into.

Well, as an adult, I've been in game development for the better part of 20 years, yet I've never made my own game from start to finish. A major reason for that was my lack of art and engineering skills (and time, of course).

I've been having a blast making all kinds of tools and games with AI. My latest is probably my most ambitious because I am dipping a toe into hardware land. It's been a ton of fun learning a whole new aspect of software development. I wouldn't be able to easily explore these ideas without AI.

Check out the flyer mockup (AI gen, obvi)!  I'm hoping to make a playable software prototype available in the near future. Not a demo or pre-release; just a simple prototype to gameplay and flow feedback from anyone interested.

If anyone is doing something similar, whether virtual pet or hardware or both, I'd love to geek out about it with someone. :)

comments.author: Inside_Television_34
comments.body: Good Luck Man! I believe in you!
